name: finchain-sepolia-r2b
notes: Round R2b: ledger v2 on Finchain Sepolia, worked by two FOGA Cell Accounts - the OG and cell-b - each through a delegate key of its own under one permit its owner signs once. The cells take part as themselves: the worker and the demander of record are their accounts, and each account's guard is the cell guard, bound by this deployment.

Both cells are the owner's: they are declared under one operator, 1, and are related parties of each other. Epoch 0 runs as a controlled self-test (declared-related parties are subsidized, under that label); from epoch 1 the parameters are the standard ones (declared-related parties are measured and not subsidized). The operator cap is 5000 basis points.

The delegates are keys made for this round. No key that a running FOGA node sends from takes part, and no cell's owner key sends a transaction: each signs one bounded permit, after the deployment is verified.
It supersedes the deployment of round R2a, which it names and does not change; round R2a and its evidence stay as they are.

The figures of this deployment are test points, the values of a view; nothing is issued, credited or claimable. A deployment's genesis time and epoch length are fixed for its life: two-hour epochs are this test deployment's parameter and no statement about any later one.
